# Company 025 — Niche Research Subscription

**Company ID:** `company:future:025`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:025`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-025-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no live opportunity hunting or unauthorized research access.

## Business identity

Purpose: provide deeply maintained intelligence for narrowly defined industries/topics through source-backed reports, data, alerts, searchable archives and APIs.

Problem: high-value niches are underserved by broad news/research products; professionals need curated sources, history, terminology and decision-relevant synthesis.

Value: persistent domain knowledge with provenance, not disposable summaries.

Delivery: subscription briefs/newsletters, research portal, datasets, alerts, custom reports, API, premium analyst workspace, enterprise/private knowledge feed.

## Product tree

Daily/Weekly Intelligence Briefs; Research Database; Source/Document Archive; Trend/Theme Tracker; Industry Data Tables; Company/Entity Profiles; Regulation/Policy Tracker; Pricing/Market Tracker; Competitive Landscape; Forecast/Scenario Reports; Event/Deadline Calendar; Alert Watchlists; Expert/Source Directory; Custom Research; Executive Briefs; Research API/Feed; Premium Historical Archive; Benchmark/Index products; Enterprise Knowledge Pack; Vertical Sub-niches.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: source registry, provenance/citations, taxonomy, entities, timeline, saved searches, watchlists, alerts, document annotation, confidence, fact/inference separation, cross-source comparison, report versioning, data export/API, team workspaces, accessible/localized outputs.

Customers: operators/executives, investors/researchers where lawful, consultants/agencies, vendors, professional associations, journalists/academics/nonprofits/public sector, enterprise strategy/product teams.

Verticals: any niche with enough recurring information value—specialized software, construction trades, creator economy, ecommerce categories, emerging tech, regulatory domains, supply-chain segments, local industries, publishing/media, cybersecurity subfields. Each niche is a product/pack unless operationally distinct enough for a future spinoff.

## Brain / architecture

Domain Brain should build terminology/entity/source knowledge, detect emerging themes, compare evidence, synthesize with citations and clearly label forecasts/uncertainty. Architecture: source registry, collectors for public/licensed sources, document/search/RAG, entity/knowledge graph, temporal store, structured datasets, rules/alerts, LLM synthesis with citations, forecasting/statistics where data supports.

## Agents

Research Planner, Source Monitor, Document Analyst, Data Collector, Entity/Taxonomy Agent, Trend Analyst, Regulation Analyst, Competitive Analyst, Fact Checker, Citation Agent, Forecast/Scenario Agent, Report Editor, Alert Curator, Archive Librarian.

## Deterministic services

Source fetch/feed; document parser; search/index; entity resolution; taxonomy; snapshot/version; dataset ETL; alert rules; calendar; citation/provenance; report renderer; subscription/entitlement; export/API.

## Workflow

Define niche/questions → source registry/rights → continuous collection → classify/entity-link → verify/provenance → data/time-series update → trend/event detection → cited synthesis → editorial/evaluation gate → publish authorized report/feed → archive/correct/version.

## Integrations / API / data

Public/licensed feeds, government/industry sources, documents/web, data warehouses, BI, RSS/email, calendar, customer knowledge tools. APIs for sources/entities/documents/topics/timelines/data/alerts/reports.

Data moat: long curated source archive, domain ontology, entity graph, reviewed research corpus, proprietary derived datasets/indices and correction history.

## Monetization / distribution

Individual/pro/team subscriptions, premium vertical packs, datasets/API, historical archive, custom research, enterprise/private feeds, reports, benchmark/index licensing. Distribution via niche communities, partnerships, SEO/content, associations, developer/data channels; no marketing execution now.

## Security/legal/privacy

Source rights/licensing, citations, copyright limits, no paywall/access bypass, private customer research isolation, no unsupported claims, corrections/versioning, PII minimization.

## Failure / edge cases

Echo-chamber sources, rumor propagated as fact, source retraction, terminology ambiguity, low-sample forecast, hidden sponsorship, outdated dataset, source conflict. Use source ranking, corroboration, fact/inference labels, correction ledger and confidence.

## Scale / platform / overlap

One niche → portfolio of vertical research products → data/API platform. Overlap #6 data, #13 competitive, #16 regulation, #11 benchmarks. #025 focuses on editorial/domain intelligence subscription.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** source/provenance/citation, domain-pack, truth-state, knowledge graph, versioning.  
**BUILD NOW:** Command Center Brain/domain-pack architecture should support this reuse after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** source/knowledge/data pack interfaces and company isolation.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** chosen niches/sources/subscriptions/content.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** multi-niche analyst/data platform.

# Mandatory 24-part completion block

1. Product Tree: briefs/database/archive/trends/data/entities/regulation/pricing/competition/forecasts/calendar/alerts/sources/custom/executive/API/history/benchmarks/enterprise/sub-niches.
2. Feature Tree: source/provenance/taxonomy/entities/timeline/search/watchlists/alerts/annotation/confidence/comparison/version/export/workspaces.
3. Customer Tree: executives/operators/investors/consultants/vendors/associations/journalists/academics/nonprofits/public/enterprise.
4. Vertical Tree: any coherent niche with recurring information value; packs unless independently operational.
5. Brain Tree: domain knowledge, evidence comparison, trends, cited synthesis, forecast uncertainty.
6. Agent Tree: planner/source/document/data/entity/trend/regulation/competitive/fact/citation/forecast/editor/alert/archive.
7. Service Tree: fetch/parser/search/entity/taxonomy/version/ETL/alerts/calendar/provenance/render/entitlement/API.
8. Workflow Tree: define→collect→classify→verify→structure→detect→synthesize→QC→publish→archive/correct.
9. Integration Tree: public/licensed sources, web/docs, warehouse/BI/RSS/email/calendar/knowledge tools.
10. Data Tree: sources/docs/entities/topics/timelines/datasets/alerts/reports/corrections.
11. API Tree: source/entity/document/topic/timeline/data/alert/report feeds.
12. Monetization Tree: individual/pro/team/packs/data/API/history/custom/enterprise/reports/index licensing.
13. Distribution Tree: niche communities/associations/partners/SEO/content/data channels.
14. Automation Tree: collection/classification/linking/alerts/draft synthesis; editorial high-impact review remains.
15. Moat Tree: archive/ontology/entity graph/reviewed corpus/proprietary datasets/indices.
16. Platform Tree: newsletter→research database→multi-niche intelligence/data platform.
17. Risk Tree: source rights, false rumor, bias, retractions, low-quality forecasts, copyright.
18. Scale Tree: single niche→vertical portfolio→enterprise/API platform.
19. Spinoff Tree: independently large niche may be recorded, not auto-added beyond 100.
20. Command Center Dependencies: Brain/domain packs, source/provenance, search/graph, data platform, billing/entitlement.
21. Design-Now: reusable domain/knowledge pack and evidence interfaces.
22. Build-Now: Brain pack extensibility after reverse-map.
23. Safe-to-Defer: actual niches/sources/content/customer products.
24. Autonomous Mature State: collection/structure/alerts/drafts run continuously; expert-quality review focuses on novel/high-stakes interpretations; James handles portfolio strategy.

## Saturation result

Further branches are niche-specific packs or existing data/benchmark/regulatory/competitive products; spinoffs recorded only if independently valuable.

# Company 026 — License & Certification Tracker

**Company ID:** `company:future:026`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:026`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-026-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no filing, renewal payment or regulatory representation.

## Business identity

Purpose: track licenses, certifications, continuing-education requirements and renewal readiness across people, companies, equipment, locations and jurisdictions.

Problem: expirations and renewal requirements are fragmented across regulators, employers, files and spreadsheets.

Value: verified credential inventory, deadline tracking, requirement checklists, evidence and employer/professional readiness views.

## Product tree

Professional License Tracker; Company/Business License Tracker; Facility/Location License; Equipment/Vehicle Certification; Employee Credential Matrix; CE/Training Requirement Tracker; Renewal Calendar; Requirement Checklist; Document/Evidence Vault; Verification/Status Checks; Jurisdiction Rule Packs; Employer Compliance Dashboard; Individual Professional Portal; Readiness Score; Expiration/Gap Alerts; Renewal Workflow Preparation; API/OEM; Vertical Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Fields: credential ID/type, holder/entity, jurisdiction, issuer, issue/expiry, renewal window, CE hours/categories, prerequisites, documents, status/source/freshness, verification URL/result, supervisor/employer, reminders, exceptions, audit. Customers: employers, professionals, contractors, healthcare/admin organizations, trades, education, transportation, property/service businesses, staffing, government vendors. Verticals: healthcare credentials, trades/construction, insurance/financial licenses, education, transportation, food/hospitality, real estate/property, security professions, equipment/operators; legal specialist review for regulated details.

## Brain / architecture

Brain interprets requirement text, maps holder/jurisdiction to checklists, identifies missing evidence and explains readiness; it cannot assert licensure or submit renewals without verified source/policy. Deterministic deadline/recurrence/CE calculations, document registry, source verification, rules/pack versions; LLM/RAG for requirement extraction with citations.

## Agents

Credential Intake Agent, Jurisdiction Requirement Agent, Expiration Monitor, CE/Training Agent, Verification Agent, Document Evidence Agent, Readiness Analyst, Employer Matrix Agent, Renewal Prep Agent, Exception/Compliance Agent, Source Change Monitor.

## Deterministic services

Credential registry; holder/entity graph; rules/requirement packs; date/recurrence; CE ledger; document hash/store; source verification connector; alert/scheduler; workflow/checklist; audit/export; protected renewal/f payment gate.

## Workflow

Register credential → identify source/jurisdiction → import/verify status → apply requirement pack → track CE/evidence → forecast renewal readiness → alert gaps/windows → prepare renewal packet → owner/professional executes protected filing/payment → verify renewed status → archive history.

## Integrations / API / data

Regulator/public verification sources, HRIS/LMS, document storage, calendar/tasks, employer systems, training providers, credentialing platforms. APIs for credential/status/requirements/readiness/expiration/evidence.

Data moat: normalized credential/jurisdiction ontology, requirement version history, verification adapters and reviewed checklist mappings.

## Monetization / distribution

Per credential/person/location/company, employer seats, vertical packs, API, enterprise/private, professional subscription, OEM. Distribution via HR/compliance/training/industry associations/employer platforms.

## Security/legal/failure

Protect personal IDs/documents; source provenance; no false credential claims; jurisdiction changes; inactive/suspended status; name changes; grace periods; CE exceptions; ambiguous renewal windows; source outage. Use explicit status/freshness/unknown and human/regulator verification.

## Scale / overlap

Individual → employer portfolio → multi-jurisdiction credential platform. Overlap #62 credentialing autopilot; #026 tracks lifecycle/readiness, #62 handles application/onboarding workflows.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** entity/credential IDs, temporal requirements, source/provenance, document privacy, protected filing/payment actions.  
**BUILD NOW:** generic temporal/evidence pack interfaces after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** rules-pack/source adapter framework, company isolation, scheduler.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** jurisdiction data/product/integrations.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** global regulatory adapter network.

# Company 027 — Review & Reputation Autopilot

**Company ID:** `company:future:027`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:027`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-027-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no public review responses or customer messages.

## Business identity

Purpose: collect authorized/public review and customer-feedback signals, identify recurring issues, support evidence-grounded response workflows and measure reputation health across brands/locations.

Problem: organizations react inconsistently to reviews, miss systemic issues and lack cross-location/competitor context.

Value: centralized review intelligence, issue taxonomy, response assistance, recovery workflows and operational root-cause feedback.

## Product tree

Review Aggregator; Sentiment/Topic Analysis; Issue/Complaint Classification; Response Draft Assistant; Approved Response Workflow; Customer Recovery Tasking; Survey/NPS/CSAT Integration; Location/Brand Comparison; Competitor Review Comparison; Reputation Score; Recurring Root-Cause Analytics; Review Request/Feedback Routing only with consent; Alerting; Executive Reports; API/OEM; Vertical Packs.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: source/platform, review identity/reference, location/product/staff tags, language, sentiment/aspects, urgency, policy/legal flags, response status, approval, SLA, recovery outcome, recurring issue trend, authenticity/spam signal, accessibility/localization.

Customers: local/multi-location businesses, hospitality, restaurants, healthcare-adjacent practices, home services, ecommerce/brands, SaaS, franchises, agencies/reputation firms, enterprise CX.

Verticals: hospitality, food, retail/ecommerce, home services, professional services, automotive, property, SaaS/apps, education, healthcare admin. Industry-specific response/privacy constraints apply.

## Brain / architecture

Brain classifies sentiment/issues, summarizes recurring themes, drafts policy-compliant responses and identifies likely operational root causes. It must not fabricate facts, admit liability, expose customer data or post automatically without authorization. Architecture: review/source connectors, text classifier, taxonomy, LLM drafting grounded in account facts/policy, rules for approvals/privacy, analytics/time series.

## Agents

Review Intake Agent, Sentiment/Topic Agent, Urgency/Risk Agent, Response Draft Agent, Policy/Privacy Agent, Recovery Task Agent, Root-Cause Analyst, Location Benchmark Agent, Competitor Review Analyst, Survey Agent, Reputation Reporting Agent, Source Quality/Spam Agent.

## Deterministic services

Connectors; dedupe; language; taxonomy; sentiment/aspect scoring; response workflow; approval; task/SLA; alerts; survey ingestion; reputation metric engine; audit/export; communication protected-action gate.

## Workflow

Ingest review/feedback → verify source → classify sentiment/topic/risk → link location/product → determine response policy → draft cited/account-grounded response → approval → publish through authorized connector → create recovery task if needed → verify resolution → aggregate root-cause trend.

## Integrations / API / data

Review platforms/public listings, ecommerce/app stores, survey tools, CRM/support, location management, social authorized channels, BI, task systems. APIs for reviews/topics/reputation/tasks/response drafts/status.

Data moat: issue taxonomy, cross-location outcome history, response/recovery effectiveness and vertical benchmarks, with customer/reviewer data minimized.

## Monetization / distribution

Locations/brands/reviews/seats, premium competitor/survey/root-cause analytics, enterprise, agency multi-client, API/OEM, managed workflows. Distribution via local-business/CRM/support/location/ecommerce ecosystems and agencies.

## Security/privacy/legal

Public reviews may contain PII or allegations. Avoid exposing personal data, defamatory response generation or false admissions. Consent required for direct follow-up. Platform terms respected; review manipulation/fake reviews prohibited.

## Failure / edge cases

Sarcasm/multilingual errors, fake reviews, coordinated attack, legal complaint, health/privacy detail, duplicate cross-post, wrong location, platform API outage, owner facts unavailable. Use risk escalation, approved facts, human review and no fabricated response.

## Scale/overlap

Single location → franchise/multi-brand → enterprise CX reputation platform. Overlap #45 support, #89 support-QA; #027 remains external reputation/reviews.

## Classification

**DESIGN NOW:** communication protected-action, untrusted text, consent/privacy, source provenance, brand/account isolation.  
**BUILD NOW:** generic communication/draft/approval/source interfaces after reverse-map.  
**BUILD BEFORE FIRST COMPANY:** brand account identity and connector isolation.  
**COMPANY-SPECIFIC LATER:** review connectors/customer product/benchmarking/pricing.  
**SCALE-ONLY:** broad reputation benchmark network.

# Company 028 — AI Knowledge-Base Maintainer

**Company ID:** `company:future:028`  
**Primary project:** `project:company:future:028`  
**Roadmap version:** `COMPANY-028-v1.0.0`  
**Truth state:** PLANNED  
**Authorization:** roadmap/architecture only; no customer content publishing.

## Business identity

Purpose: keep internal/customer knowledge bases current, noncontradictory, source-linked and useful as products/systems change.

Problem: docs become stale, duplicated and inconsistent; ownership is unclear; AI assistants amplify obsolete answers.

Value: continuous source synchronization, contradiction/staleness detection, gap discovery, draft updates, review workflows and knowledge quality analytics.

## Product tree

Source Sync; Knowledge Inventory; Staleness Detector; Contradiction Detector; Missing-Topic/FAQ Gap Analyzer; Duplicate/Overlap Resolver; Draft Update Generator; Documentation/FAQ Generator; Provenance/Citation Manager; Version/Release Alignment; Permissions/Visibility Auditor; Review/Approval Workflow; Knowledge Analytics; Search/RAG Quality Monitor; Employee KB Pack; Customer Help Center Pack; Developer Docs Pack; Policy/Procedure Pack; API/OEM.

## Feature/customer/vertical tree

Features: source-of-truth ranking, owners, effective dates, product/version tags, citations, dependency graph, freshness SLA, semantic duplicate/contradiction, broken links, unsupported answers, gap queries, draft diffs, approval, publishing status, access control, localization, accessibility, analytics/search success.

Customers: SaaS, enterprise internal knowledge, support teams, developer platforms, HR/IT, operations, regulated organizations, agencies, ecommerce/service businesses.

Verticals: product/support docs, developer/API docs, employee SOP, compliance/policy, onboarding/training, customer FAQ, field service, healthcare administrative knowledge. Sensitive domains require stricter source and review gates.

## Brain / architecture

Brain understands document/source hierarchy, semantic relationships, version context and user question patterns. It detects stale/contradictory material, proposes reconciled drafts and identifies gaps; it cannot overwrite canonical source or publish without policy.
